content.short: Noox enables the creation of customizable soulbound NFTs.
content.description: Noox helps you explore, collect, and share your Web3 achievements based on your historical interactions with decentralized applications on the Ethereum network. The achievements you earn can be issued as soulbound NFTs, providing a durable signal of your commitment to a particular protocol or community. Badges are a popular way to display this commitment, and Noox equips groups to engage with members, recognize contributions, and showcase shared activity within their communities.
content.meta: Noox supports creating customizable soulbound NFTs. Discover Noox and other DAO Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
